1.web: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
1.asv: The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, hath spoken, And called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

2.web: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
2.asv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

3.web: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
3.asv: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence: A fire devoureth before him, And it is very tempestuous round about him.

4.web: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
4.asv: He calleth to the heavens above, And to the earth, that he may judge his people:

5.web: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
5.asv: Gather my saints together unto me, Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

6.web: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
6.asv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; For God is judge himself. [Selah

7.web: “Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
7.asv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, even thy God.

8.web: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
8.asv: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; And thy burnt-offerings are continually before me.

9.web: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
9.asv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, Nor he-goats out of thy folds.

10.web: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
10.asv: For every beast of the forest is mine, And the cattle upon a thousand hills.

11.web: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
11.asv: I know all the birds of the mountains; And the wild beasts of the field are mine.

12.web: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
12.asv: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; For the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

13.web: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
13.asv: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?

14.web: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
14.asv: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; And pay thy vows unto the Most High;

15.web: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
15.asv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

16.web: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
16.asv: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, And that thou hast taken my covenant in thy mouth,

17.web: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
17.asv: Seeing that thou hatest instruction, And castest my words behind thee?

18.web: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
18.asv: When thou sawest a thief, thou consentedst with him, And hast been partaker with adulterers.

19.web: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
19.asv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, And thy tongue frameth deceit.

20.web: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
20.asv: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

21.web: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
21.asv: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such a one as thyself: ButI will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

22.web: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
22.asv: Now consider this, ye that forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver:

23.web: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
23.asv: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifieth me; And to him that ordereth his way aright Will I show the salvation of God.
